title.zh: Denmark Data Breach Exposes 8.8M People's Personal Data
title.en: Denmark Data Breach Exposes 8.8M People's Personal Data

current_state.zh: Denmark's CPR registry suffered unauthorized access exposing the personal data of roughly 8.8 million people, with community discussion linking it to an earlier Technical University of Denmark breach that leaked the same national ID numbers.
current_state.en: Denmark's CPR registry suffered unauthorized access exposing the personal data of roughly 8.8 million people, with community discussion linking it to an earlier Technical University of Denmark breach that leaked the same national ID numbers.
